definition: Current measured exact-area household weights, available model prices and KB-comparison same-complex area overlay. Price levels use available stock at each date; indices use adjacent/base common cohorts. Neither is an official KB index or an observed transaction median.
limits: Fixed current geography and surviving measured inventory, not historical inventory.
Weak/stale and additional area estimates retained with coverage.
Null means withheld, never zero; index paths cannot cross a withheld link.
Peak window 2021-01 to 2022-12; subsequent minimum through 2023-12 is not necessarily a later all-time low.
Full-198-month fixed cohort is too limited for an adequate group price sensitivity.
